cohort: Pregnant women (26,973 from France and 22,046 from Canada) who delivered singletons between 2009 and 2011
finding: Obesity was significantly associated with an increased rate of hypertensive disorders of pregnancy, cesarean delivery, and macrosomia in both cohorts, with similar trends of increased risk despite varying obesity prevalence.
mod_finding: Caesarean delivery was more common in obese women.
